sources.snippet: 2024.09.19: The instruction-tuned Qwen2-VL-72B model and its quantized version [AWQ, GPTQ-Int4, GPTQ-Int8] are now available. We have also released the Qwen2-VL paper simultaneously. 2024.08.30: We have released the Qwen2-VL series. The 2B and 7B models are now available, and the 72B model for open source is coming soon.

sources.snippet: Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct is a multimodal vision-language model with 7 billion parameters that can process both images and text, enabling visual question answering, image description, and other vision-language tasks. This is based on the implementation of Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct found here. This repository contains scripts for optimized on-device export suitable to run on Qualcomm® devices. More ...
